resources.string: This device is not linked to an access yet. Pick one of three ways:
Enter the username and password from your order.
Open the page on your phone and enter your login or M3U link there.
Send a photo of this screen via WhatsApp or Telegram – we set everything up for you.
german4k.com is not reachable right now. Check the internet connection of this device and try again.
Device id could not be read
Scan to renew on your phone – or open german4k.com/verlaengern
Scan to set up on your phone
This area is not finished yet. Things may be missing or wrong – view it anyway?
Check your connection here or send the error to German4K – nobody has to type anything.
Sent. We can see what happened now.
Still stuck? Write to us on WhatsApp or Telegram – german4k.com
Connection, access and channels answer normally. If the picture still fails, write to us – we can see the details now.
This device has no connection. Check WiFi or the network cable; if nothing helps, unplug the router for three minutes.
Your network wants a login first
This WiFi (hotel, guest or company network) asks you to sign in on a web page first. Open any page in a browser, complete the sign-in, then try again.
The internet works, but this network does not let our address through – usually a filter or parental control in the router. Try a phone hotspot to be sure, then allow german4k.tv in the router.
Your provider is blocking right now
Everything of ours answers, but no channel plays. Some providers block during live matches. A VPN helps, and after the match it works again by itself.
One of our two connections was unreachable, the app switched by itself. The picture is back – nothing to do.
Your access is in use somewhere else, or an old session is stuck. Close the app on the other device – or release the connection here.
This access has run out. Renew it, then press “Check again” – the list comes straight back.
Your access is not enabled for this country. Write to us, we will sort it out.
The clock of this device is wrong
The time is far off. The guide then looks shifted and catch-up misses. Set date and time to automatic in the device settings.
We could not narrow it down. Send the error to us – then we can see what happened without you typing anything.
Android asks once before German4K Ultra may install an update. Allow it in the next screen, then start the update again.
Fire TV asks once before German4K Ultra may install an update: Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options › Apps from unknown sources › German4K Ultra. Then start the update again.
The clock of this device is wrong – the guide will look shifted. Set date and time to automatic.
Released. Start the channel again in a moment.

Your access is fine — the connection this device goes out through is being turned away. This happens with some VPN locations and with the \"threat protection\" some VPNs have built in. Pick another country in your VPN, or switch that protection off; without a VPN it usually works straight away.
